title.value: Learning to Learn without Forgetting by Maximizing Transfer and Minimizing Interference

analysis.description: This paper addresses the challenge of continual learning over non-stationary distributions in neural networks. It proposes a new algorithm, Meta-Experience Replay (MER), which combines experience replay and optimization-based meta-learning to enhance continual learning. The paper demonstrates that MER can outperform traditional techniques by improving transfer and minimizing interference in a variety of settings.

type.justification: The paper conducts several experiments across continual lifelong learning benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments to demonstrate the efficacy of MER.
type.quote: We conduct experiments across continual lifelong supervised learn- ing benchmarks and non-stationary reinforcement learning environments demonstrating that our approach consistently outperforms recently proposed baselines for continual learning.
